newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle market steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle market steady - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady, compared to Monday's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 67.00-74.00; 700-800 lbs 63.00-70.90, including 46 head 739 lbs 70.90; 800-900 lbs 59.75-63.50. Medium and Large 2 600-700 lbs few 62.25. Holstein Large 2 600-700 lbs few 55.75; 15 head 820 lbs 57.70.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 60.00-68.00, including 44 head 690 lbs 64.90; 700-800 lbs 57.00-58.00. Medium and Large 2 500-600 lbs 57.50-62.50. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 1,300
